name: How much does entry door installation cost in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: How much does entry door installation cost in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of entry door installation in Orange County varies widely based on several factors, including the door material (steel, fiberglass, wood), type (pre-hung, slab, custom), and any necessary structural modifications. Basic pre-hung door installations can start from a few hundred dollars for labor, plus the cost of the door itself. More complex projects involving custom doors, sidelights, transoms, or significant frame repairs will incur higher costs. It's recommended to get a detailed quote that includes both the door unit and installation services to understand the total investment.
